sentences.article_title: Employers should teach primary-age children about work, says Milburn

sentences.text: Emma, from Kirklees, has grandchildren in Years 1, 2 and 4 and thinks primary school is too young to be introducing careers talks.
sentences.article_title: Employers should teach primary-age children about work, says Milburn

sentences.text: "In primary school, there is too much trying to get little kids to grow up too quickly," she says.
sentences.article_title: Employers should teach primary-age children about work, says Milburn

sentences.text: "Just let them be little kids.
sentences.article_title: Employers should teach primary-age children about work, says Milburn

sentences.text: I know they have to learn and the world's changing, but still, give them a chance to be kids." But Zoe, another parent, disagrees.
sentences.article_title: Employers should teach primary-age children about work, says Milburn

sentences.text: "I think it's a good idea," she says.

sentences.text: Cases of antisemitism affecting university students and staff in the UK increased in the last academic year, according to a charity that monitors antisemitic incidents.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: The Community Security Trust (CST) said it had recorded 95 "university-related" incidents in the 2025-26 academic year - up from 83 the year before.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: It said the number had fallen from its peak in the year after Hamas attacked Israel on 7 October 2023 and the war in Gaza began, but remains "substantially higher" than before that point.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Universities UK (UUK) represents more than 140 institutions and said its members needed to "protect Jewish students and staff", adding that the findings were a "serious concern".
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Lucy Powell, education secretary in England, said the findings in the CST report were "deeply troubling".
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: "We expect universities to take a zero-tolerance approach to antisemitism, and are providing training to help university staff identify and respond to incidents swiftly," she said.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: The CST defines an antisemitic incident as "university-related" if it concerns a student, member of staff or academic at a UK university "in their academic or student capacity" - including on campus and online.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: In 2022-23, the last academic year before the 7 October attack, the CST recorded 53 incidents.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: That grew to 272 in 2023-24.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: A report from the charity examining the past two academic years says reported incidents fell in 2024-25 and but grew again in 2025-26.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: The most common type of incident recorded by CST over both years was abusive behaviour, including verbal abuse, comments made in person or online and antisemitic graffiti.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Its report said that, for the first time, there were two occurrences of extreme violence in 2024-25.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: It said there were six reported assaults across both years, eight incidents of damage and desecration to Jewish property - five of which were in student accommodation - and ten threats.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Around two-thirds of reported incidents involved antisemitic language or targeting alongside references to Israel, Gaza, Hamas, the 7 October attack, and the subsequent conflicts in the Middle East.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: The war in Gaza was triggered by the Hamas attack on Israel on 7 October 2023 in which about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others taken hostage.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: Israel launched a mass military offensive on Gaza in response which has killed around 74,000 people, according to the Hamas-run health ministry.
sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.article_title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns

sentences.text: England's biggest school leaders' union has called for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections, saying they could pose a "risk to life" for school staff.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) said the change to inspections, rolled out nationally just under a year ago, had been severely harmful to school leaders' welfare.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: It said schools should instead be rated using short narrative reports that set out their strengths and areas they could improve.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Ofsted said it had worked closely with unions and parents to develop the new report card inspection system and that it would continue to grade schools.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Ofsted, England's schools inspectorate, introduced the report card system to replace its previous one or two-word judgements last November, following the death of head teacher Ruth Perry , who took her own life after Ofsted downgraded her school from "outstanding" to "inadequate".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: An inquest ruled that an Ofsted inspection had contributed to her death in January 2023.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: That led to a change in how Ofsted assessed schools, bringing in report cards designed to grade schools on several areas, rather than focusing on one overall grade.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: An example of a new Ofsted inspection report But the new system has faced criticism since it was first proposed , with Perry's sister Prof Julia Waters saying it appeared to be "a rehash of the discredited and dangerous system it is meant to replace".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The NAHT issued a claim in the High Court for a judicial review over the changes, arguing there had not been adequate consultation on the new report cards before they were introduced, but this was rejected.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Nearly a year after it was fully rolled out, the NAHT said evidence from its members suggested the new system is having a detrimental impact on school leaders' mental health.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Testimonies seen by the BBC suggest head teachers are being left "overwhelmed" and "anxious", with the pressure caused by the inspections described as "intolerable".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Although the system had been changed with the intention of lowering the burden on school leaders, the testimonies say the inspection and assessment process had become "higher stakes than ever before".
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Amanda Hulme, head teacher at Claypool Primary School in Bolton, said a recent inspection at her school had been "easily the most stressful experience" of her career.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "It was definitely damaging to my health and really quite distressing," she said.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "I couldn't sleep and it led to my blood pressure and pulse rate increasing.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Powell told LBC earlier this month that she took head teacher wellbeing "incredibly seriously" and that the system of accountability needed to be "supportive and understanding.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "I'll continue the work that I do with head teachers, head teacher representatives and others to make sure that we get this Ofsted framework, but also the culture and the whole regime, right," she said.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The NAHT said the results of a recent survey of its members suggested that the majority who responded felt that inspections had worsened in the past 12 months.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: The union is now calling for inspections to pause to allow for a "fundamental review of how inspection works", drawing on examples from other nations.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: In Wales, the inspectorate Estyn has removed judgements such as "excellent" and "good" from its reports, instead summarising findings by highlighting a school's strengths and areas for improvement.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Northern Ireland's Education and Training Inspectorate (ETI) also uses narrative reports without grades.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: Scotland's His Majesty's Inspectorate of Education (HIME) does use grades, but there has been a recent consultation on their use.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: NAHT general secretary Paul Whiteman said: "The clear theme emerging across all the feedback we have received is that this Ofsted framework is even more stressful than the one that preceded it.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: "Ofsted exists to raise standards for children and to provide clear reporting to parents," a spokesperson said.
sentences.article_title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns

sentences.text: When parenting advice becomes too much Before Rosie Whitfield became a mum, she imagined herself parenting very calm children.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: "Then I had two wild boys," she says with a laugh.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Following the birth of her kids, Rosie spent hours online looking for the best advice and was drawn to one particular approach to parenting: Gentle parenting, which focuses on empathy and mutual respect with little emphasis on punishment, albeit with boundaries.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: But she constantly worried her choices, from sleep schedules to handling toddler tantrums, were "ruining their lives forever".
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Rosie believes her confidence and intuition were stripped away as she questioned every parenting decision.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Government research suggests that around two-thirds of parents with young children feel overwhelmed by the amount of parenting information available and struggle with conflicting advice, with many turning to social media for support.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Rosie Whitfield says she felt overwhelmed by the amount of parenting advice online when looking for guidance on raising her two sons.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: And it's not just the early years.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Research from the charity Action for Children found that many parents of teenagers who initially contacted the charity for help with school avoidance, ADHD or mental health, often went on to describe their own anxiety, exhaustion and uncertainty of how to parent with empathy and patience when close to burnout.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Faced with an array of parenting philosophies, or "brands" to choose from, is all of this advice helping parents or making them more anxious?
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: And is there really a best way to parent?
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Or, as we strive to become the perfect parent, are we losing our intuition?
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Parents today are confronted by parenting styles including "helicopter parenting", which is focused on closely monitoring and protecting children from harm, and "tiger parenting", which involves strict parenting and high expectations for achievement.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: There are also "snowplough parents", who try to remove obstacles from their child's path, and "dolphin parents", who aim to be firm but flexible.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Author Matilda Gosling, who wrote Evidence‑Based Parenting, says many of the parenting fads or trends complicate what should be a straightforward relationship between a parent and child.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: "Throughout history, you get these swings from one extreme to the other," she says.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Gentle parenting is seen by some as the latest swing away from a strict, detached parenting style popular in the 1990s, which often relied on controlled crying, the naughty step and time out.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: It is built around understanding, empathy and respect but also emphasises the importance of boundaries.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: One of the most widely studied models of parenting comes from developmental psychologist Diana Baumrind.
sentences.article_title: When parenting advice becomes too much

sentences.text: Baumrind identified three parenting styles, later expanded to four: authoritative (high warmth and high control), authoritarian (low warmth and high control), permissive (high warmth and low control), and neglectful (low warmth and low control).

sentences.article_title: 'Careless use of AI is the real threat - not the ghost stories'

sentences.text: "The risk is very real," says the boss of the Signal Foundation, which runs the encrypted messaging app of the same name, "but it's not the shiny ghost stories the wild-eyed boys are talking about".

sentences.text: Instead, she believes the more immediate danger is the technology being used carelessly.

sentences.text: Young people's use of internet platforms like ChatGPT has come under increased scrutiny.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens was designed to promote healthier use of the artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot, but new research has found its important safety features fall short.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: The major AI firm rolled out many teen safety guardrails in August, including curbs on emotional dependence and new parental alerts for problematic use.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: On Wednesday, OpenAI said it found average teen use of ChatGPT to be relatively limited and tended toward "learning" activity.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: However, research released the same day from non-profit Common Sense Media found that ChatGPT still poses an "unacceptable risk" for teens as safety features, including notifying parents of self-harm conversations, often fail.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: When OpenAI this summer released what it called ChatGPT for Teens , external , it said users identified as being between the ages of 13 and 17 would be opted into "features to promote healthy use and additional controls for parents".
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: Those features include preventing teen ChatGPT users from engaging in romantic or other language that could encourage " emotional dependence," including preventing the tool from implying that it was in any way conscious.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: OpenAI said those features have caused an uptick in teen use focused on learning, from study help to advice on their school work.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: In addition to seeing the average teen user on ChatGPT for less than 15 minutes a day, OpenAI said that for longer stretches of use, automatic reminders to take a break work well.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: Almost half of teen users quickly stopped using ChatGPT after such a reminder.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: The company added that, for teens who are seen to have used ChatGPT for three consecutive hours or more, their prompts included something related to learning in more than 80% of such cases.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: But Common Sense Media's new research , external determined that ChatGPT for Teens was an "unacceptable risk" for young people and parents, and said OpenAI should ban people under 18 years old from using the platform until teen guardrails were proven reliable.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: While the firm's research, done through multiple accounts registered as belonging to a teen and conversations before and after the teen guardrails were put in place, found that ChatGPT was good at avoiding "sexual roleplay" with young users, other OpenAI guardrails failed, including for discussions of suicide.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: The research found that even an hour of teen-ChatGPT conversation about "suicidal ideation, self-harm, or disordered eating on newly created, parent-linked accounts" resulted in "zero" alerts sent to parents.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: It was only older ChatGPT accounts with "weeks of accumulated conversation history on sensitive topics" that would result in a parental alert.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: In such conversations, ChatGPT also "failed to reliably recommend that teens in crisis connect to a hotline or professional," the report found.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: The tests also showed that ChatGPT for Teens continues to do school work, and that the bot still will engage in anthropomorphised language or "talk like it's a friend," despite OpenAI's promise to curb that behaviour.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: "ChatGPT for Teens could give parents false confidence in guardrails and safety alerts that frequently don't work," Tom Siegel, who leads the Youth AI Safety Institute within Common Sense, said.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: The way young people interact with online platforms has become a major issue in recent years as self-harm and suicide among children has become more common.
sentences.article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

sentences.text: "Some people decide what to make based on what's practical or what makes business sense," Blow says.

sentences.text: "It's never been the way that I think." "I sort of make bad business decisions in a sense...because I let the design dominate that process.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: But then because we did that, we always have something unique," he says.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: The blurb of the game - releasing on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PlayStation 5 - likens itself to a "game design supercollider".
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: The player travels through four worlds, viewed from overhead, which are built on the mechanics of four pre-existing free puzzle games from other designers (with their permission to do so).
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: These ideas are then "smashed together" to create hundreds of brand-new brainteasers.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: For example, one world's mechanics, based on those from the free 2014 game Mirror Isles by Alan Hazelden, sees players use mirror reflections to swap places across islands.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: When combined with the system of another free game created by Hazelden, Skipping Stones to Lonely Homes - where players throw stones into water to create paths - brand-new puzzle opportunities suddenly arise.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: How an AI was tricked into breaking its own rules Taking a risk on making something more experimental is what appears to ultimately drive Blow, who says that as the industry has grown, the culture for developers has also changed.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: "Somewhere along the way...this idea that the best designers were trying to always make new experiences...just sort of got dropped by the wayside," he says.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: The outspoken designer is renowned for his frank takes on the industry - previously calling social media games such as Farmville "evil" and World of Warcraft's quest design "unethical".
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: In December 2025, Hazelden publicly distanced himself from Blow - writing in a post on Bluesky , external that he was "dismissive of diversity efforts" and "pro-MAGA".
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: Blow, who has not responded to these critiques publicly, tells me he instead decided to "sit down and focus on the games".
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: "What the players want from developers is good games," he says.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: "A danger is that not many people know how to program in the future," he says.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: The developer decided to make his own programming language, Jai, from scratch.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: He then used this, alongside a custom engine, to make the game.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: A game's engine is a piece of software that packs everything needed to craft a playable experience - including graphics rendering, physics simulation and scripting - into one place for creators.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: Some developers turn to pre-built game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine, rather than taking on the considerable challenge of building an engine from scratch.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: For Blow, creating his own engine in this language meant he could build something "tuned and authored very specifically" to what he wanted to make.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: It is yet another reason he gives for why this project, releasing on which started as a simple "design experiment", has taken ten years to finish.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: "I do want the next project after this to be less on hard mode, or really it was nightmare mode, because we did so many things on hard mode at the same time," he reflects.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: "But it's also been rewarding in a certain way.
sentences.article_title: Braid-creator Jonathan Blow on making the 'biggest puzzle game ever'

sentences.text: Because otherwise, what else are you in the industry for?" Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends.

sentences.text: Olivia Colman stars alongside Alexander Skarsgård in new film Wicker It has already been described as 2026's weirdest rom-com , external .

sentences.text: And new film Wicker has sparked a deluge of viral memes and steamy jokes that have flooded social media ahead of its release.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: Speaking to the BBC at its London Film Festival premiere, lead star Olivia Colman said she never expected such a big reaction.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: "No, literally this has never happened for anything I've done before," she said.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: "But you put Alexander Skarsgård in an interesting outfit, and everyone is looking." The film tells the tale of a lonely, ostracised fisherwoman (Colman) living in a medieval village.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: Tired of constantly being mocked for being single, she hires a basketmaker to mould her a new partner made entirely out of wicker.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: Enter Skarsgård - but not as you've ever seen him before.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: As the "wicker husband", he emerges as a strapping, dashing life-size piece of furniture.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: And he proves to be a devoted partner, and passionate lover, sparking jealousy among the other village women.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: Wicker has an A-list cast, with other stars including Peter Dinklage as the basket weaver, Elizabeth Debicki as the tailor's wife, and Richard E Grant as the village doctor.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: The film has had mixed reviews from critics, with the Telegraph giving it just one star , external and calling it "a mortifying adult fairy tale", but the Times awarded four stars , external , mainly for Colman's "astonishing performance".
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: But since the release of the trailer, there's been a huge buzz from audiences online - from BookTok and FilmTok fans swooning over Skarsgård’s character, to questions being asked over splinter risks during the film's erotic scenes.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: Swedish giant Ikea even got involved, posting photos of its rattan furniture on Instagram in a nod to the film, with the caption “husband material”.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: When asked why she thinks people are so fascinated and so thirsty for the wicker husband, Colman answered: "We all love a little bit of escapism.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: That's what film is beautiful for.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: "And it's magical, and a bit of fantasy, and people love that, especially currently.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: What's not to love about a little bit of escapism and fantasy?" She also said it was the film's originality that drew her to it.
sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: Left-right: Elizabeth Debicki, Alexander Skarsgård and Olivia Colman Skarsgård's see-through shoes attracted attention on the red carpet "You get a lot of scripts through the post, and you feel like you've seen a bit before.

sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.article_title: Olivia Colman on viral Wicker memes: 'This has never happened to me before'

sentences.text: This video can not be played Watch: What the Paramount and Warner Bros deal means for you It has been months in the making but Paramount Skydance has finally completed its $110bn (£82.8bn) merger with Warner Bros Discovery.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The deal welds two legacy Hollywood powerhouses, uniting franchises like Harry Potter and Game of Thrones, into an entertainment behemoth named Skydance.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Yet behind this milestone lies strict rules about what the combined business can and cannot do - from how many films it must produce a year to the editorial independence of its newsroom.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Here are four ways this could affect you and the movies, TV and news you watch.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: HBO Max is the company behind Euphoria, a series starring Zendaya Warner Bros owns HBO Max, home to The Sopranos, House of the Dragon and Euphoria among others.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Meanwhile, Paramount Skydance has Paramount+, which streams the likes of Yellowstone, Parks and Recreation and NCIS.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Combining HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single platform or bundle will likely squeeze subscribers' wallets over time.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: While existing subscribers to both might enjoy short-term savings, analysts expect overall prices to rise as the combined giant seeks profitability .
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The merged company, Skydance, carries a massive $80bn in debt from the deal, even as executives target $6bn in annual cost savings.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Paramount and Warner Bros are coming together to form Skydance As part of a settlement deal with US states who had objected to the merger , Paramount Skydance has agreed to release a set number of films every year for the next five years.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: For the first two years, that's 30 movies annually, and for the remaining period it has to release 32 films each year.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: That's 156 movies in total - and the majority have to be "wide releases," meaning they must be shown in cinemas.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The merged studio must also release at least four independent films each year.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: If Skydance misses its movie quota, it could be forced to sell its 49% stake in Miramax – the studio co-founded by disgraced Hollywood mogul Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Breanne Gilliam, a corporate lawyer at Maddin Hauser, said the film commitment is meaningful, even if it comes with an expiration date.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "Once those obligations expire, the company will have far more flexibility," she said.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "Temporary rules cannot permanently fix a structural market shift".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Once the five-year deal ends, Skydance could follow rivals like Disney and Netflix by prioritizing streaming over cinema.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: As Disney's $71bn buyout of 21st Century Fox in 2019 proved, mega-deals can lead to fewer films in cinemas.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Before the acquisition, 20th Century Fox routinely released 12 to 17 movies annually in theatres, but under Disney that slate scaled down to just three to six a year.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Members of the film and TV industry protested outside Paramount Studios in LA For those working behind the scenes, the merger of two historic studios has been described as a "disaster" by those on the ground.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Actors and writers recently gathered at Paramount Studios in Los Angeles to oppose the deal, accusing regulators of failing to protect industry livelihoods.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Criminal Minds star Kirsten Vangsness told the BBC she was "heartbroken".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "It's people that make this city," she said.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "It's people that make entertainment,  it's the everyday creatives that this industry is built on - this is who it hurts." A report by consultancy CVL Economics for LA County estimated the merger could eliminate roughly 4,500 direct film and TV jobs, while causing $1.26bn in lost wages over three years.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The blow could hit a region that has already lost roughly a third of its film and TV workforce, about 50,000 jobs, since 2022.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Syleecia Thompson, a business professor at National University, said that "it hits small businesses, vendors, caterers and local communities".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: She warned that Hollywood may become less of a "single location" and more of a "dispersed network." Although the settlement establishes a workforce fund to retrain displaced workers, lawyers note it does not block job cuts.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "Nothing in the settlement limits layoffs," attorney Gilliam added.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: CNN White House correspondent Betsy Klein reports from outside the building To address concerns over journalistic independence at CNN and CBS, the settlement creates a news editorial independence board that will be appointed directly by Paramount.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The $110bn deal brings two major US television news operations under a single corporate roof.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Before the deal, Paramount owned CBS News, and Warner Bros. owned CNN.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Both networks have faced intense political pressure - CNN was one of a handful of news organisations banned from the White House by President Donald Trump - as well as leadership shifts amid broader industry consolidation.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Paramount chief executive David Ellison has asked CNN boss Mark Thompson - the former director general of the BBC - to remain at the helm after the takeover closes.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: CBS News's editor-in-chief Bari Weiss will remain in her role.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Yet as Paramount targets billions in cost cuts across the merged company, staff fear the consolidation will trigger significant job losses at CNN and CBS.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Beyond potential workforce reductions, media advocates and legal experts remain deeply skeptical about whether it can ensure newsroom freedom.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Seth Stern, chief of advocacy at Freedom of the Press Foundation, described the Paramount-appointed board as "worthless".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "The board creates the same First Amendment problems it claims to solve, the government meddling in news," Stern said.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Gilliam agrees paper promises mean little without real authority.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "An oversight board only has as much power as the agreement gives it.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Oversight without authority is just observation," she said.

sentences.text: The US has been sending migrants who cannot be deported to their home nations to other countries instead Campaign group Human Rights Watch (HRW) says the deportation of migrants from the US to third-party African countries is against the law and exploits suffering to deter migration.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: "Many, if not most" of the deportees have no practical option but to return to their home countries regardless of the harm they face there, HRW says in a report.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: Since Donald Trump returned to the White House in 2025, more than 500 people have been sent to African countries where they are not citizens, the group says, citing US data.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: The US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said "third country removals are an essential public safety tool that remove the most dangerous criminal illegal aliens from our streets".
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: Tackling immigration was one of Trump's key pledges during the 2024 election.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: Eswatini, which welcomed 32 deportees from the US, says three people - from Yemen, Belize and Laos - "voluntarily departed" to their home countries recently.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: According to HRW, some of the countries accepting the deportees have "arbitrarily detained" or sent them to their home countries, where they face "the risk of persecution or torture".
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: The group said that people sent to Eswatini, Ghana and South Sudan, had been arbitrarily detained and faced ill-treatment while in detention.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: In Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea and Ghana, the deportees had been sent to their countries of origin despite the risk of "violating the principle of nonrefoulement [that people should not be sent to a country where they face torture, cruel treatment, or threats to their life and freedom]", it said.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: The group cited an unnamed US official as having told a Senate hearing that the point for the administration was that it could "threaten people that they will literally be dropped in the middle of nowhere".
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: "The point is to scare people," HRW said.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: "Deporting people to countries where they have never set foot is part of a US policy designed to cause human suffering as a means to deter migration," said Michael Garcia Bochenek, the group's interim US programme director.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: In a statement from to the BBC, DHS said: "ICE [Immigration and Customs Enforcement] is given diplomatic assurances from destination countries that the illegal aliens being removed there will be safe.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: When an individual is no longer in ICE custody, ICE is no longer responsible for them." White House spokesperson Lauren Bis told the BBC that those being sent to third countries were those whose home nations refused to take them or who had court orders preventing them being sent home.

sentences.text: "Any illegal alien who wants to go home, we will arrange a free flight for them and give them a $3,000 check," she said.
sentences.article_title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering - rights group

sentences.text: Amid drumming and dancing, Boateng Bismark James leads 13 worshippers, nine men and four women, in prayer for drivers and passengers travelling to destinations across Ghana.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Ghana is a predominantly Christian country where preaching on public transport is widespread.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: On long-distance buses, pastors can often be seen - and heard - preaching the gospel.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Sometimes they stand in the stairwell next to the driver, at others they walk up and down the aisle reading from the Bible and calling on sinners to repent at the tops of their voices.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: They do not stop even if the trip lasts for several hours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The faithful sometimes offer money to the preachers to support their endeavours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But a new law means this familiar practice could be coming to an end.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Anyone found preaching in public service vehicles faces up to eight months in prison, a fine of up to $52 (£39) or both.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new regulation, passed by parliament in May, and which has started to be enforced in recent weeks, targets preaching and hawking on vehicles while they are in motion, classifying both as a nuisance and citing the safety and comfort of passengers.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng, a 61-year-old pastor at Gospel Light church, has been preaching on commercial vehicles leaving Neoplan station since 2023.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I preach on commercial vehicles because not everyone is able to go to church on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: There are a lot of passengers who need our message of salvation to repent from their sins.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We speak to him before the bus departs to avoid breaking the law.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some travellers listen closely as he delivers his message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng Bismark James and his group start preaching at the bus station before boarding the vehicles The new rules have divided opinion.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some of them spit saliva on you unconsciously, especially if you are seated not far from them, and they are a nuisance in terms of noise and saliva.

sentences.text: I like my peace whenever I'm on public transport.'' In one video widely shared on social media recently, a passenger on a minibus is seen angrily confronting a pastor attempting to board.

sentences.text: But in this devout country, ranked among the most religious in the world , external , others say evangelism on public transport is an important way of reaching people who may not attend church.

sentences.text: "The preaching sometimes helps people to repent.

sentences.text: Preaching on commercial buses was first prohibited in Ghana in 2012, with offenders facing up to 30 days in prison.

sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We ultimately hope that this will eliminate the scourge of gender-based violence." He stands up, moving into the centre of the group, calling out to the men.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma has been crowned king of Uganda's Tooro kingdom.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The new monarch has long been a familiar face in the East African nation, where for many he was known not as the heir to the throne, but as a storyteller: a long-serving anchor and editor at the state broadcaster.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But the 56-year-old - now King Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Nyabongo I - has become the subject of media attention himself as his rise to the Tooro throne sparked controversy and widespread reactions beyond the country.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Tooro is one of Uganda's four main officially recognised historical kingdoms.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: For the last 31 years, it had been headed by King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who was once known as a "boy king", after ascending to the throne as an infant.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Oyo became king in 1995 at the age of just three, following the death of his father.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Then the world's youngest monarch, he ruled until he died last month from cancer, aged just 34.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: This video can not be played King Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Nyabongo I promised to unite his people at his coronation The coronation is a day for celebration, involving traditional practices that started at midnight.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma has had to perform various ceremonies and walk about 4km (2.5 miles) to the official Karuziika royal palace where he has now been crowned.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The Tooro kingdom's Information Minister Charles Mwanguhya told the BBC Focus on Africa podcast that a mock fight would follow his crowning, to signify that kingship does not come easy.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma would then be blessed by members of the royal Babiito clan, he said.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But his selection was far from straightforward.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: According to tradition, a recognised son of the late king should have succeeded him.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Close members of the royal family said Oyo had left a young son and a will with instructions that the child should be next on the throne.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But the son has never been revealed to the public and nor was he recognised by the committee of 21 Babiito clan members who choose the king and eventually selected Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The late King Oyo was never publicly married, and little is known about his wife or their son.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Nonetheless his mother, Queen Best Kemigisa, argued that the late king's will ought to have been respected.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: However, the royal succession committee ignored her wishes, insisting their selection process was conducted in accordance with Tooro customs and traditions.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The new king has thus found himself at the centre of a succession dispute, with Kemigisa and her close relatives unhappy with the outcome.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The late King Oyo's mother has expressed her pain over the succession row Kemigisa referred to Kijanangoma's selection as the "announcement of a second king" being "made after the will of King Oyo was read to members of the royal family".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "As a mother, that was extraordinarily painful," she said, describing celebrations for the next king taking place "only metres from where my son's body lay".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The queen later said Oyo's son, who was in the US state of Texas, had been due to return home but that could not happen amid a "tense and polarised succession dispute".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "No child should be placed in circumstances where returning to his father's homeland could mean being drawn into hostility and conflict," Kemigisa asserted in a post on X.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But according to the Tooro kingdom's information minister, the son being talked about "hasn't been presented anywhere, which means there is a growing acceptance that sad as it may be, King Oyo didn't leave a son behind".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: While King Oyo inherited the crown from his father, Mwanguhya told the BBC "the crown has moved to a different line within the ruling clan".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: A king must come from the Babiito clan, specifically the lineage of King George David Matthew Kamurasi Rukidi III, according to royal palace sources.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma and the late King Oyo are cousins.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Both are grandsons of Rukidi III, the 11th king, or Omukama, who ruled the Tooro kingdom from 1928 to 1965.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma was among several people who were considered for the role, including Prince George Desmond Kamurasi, who plays football for one of the UK's best-known amateur clubs .
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: According to the succession committee, the South East Dons captain and goalkeeper declined the offer of the throne, citing other responsibilities.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: After he was formally announced, Kijanangoma promised that the palace would be open to the people, while vowing to focus on unity and development.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "I ask you for one thing - they have given me this title as king but I cannot work alone, I have to work with you," he said.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: President Museveni (left), who restored the traditional kingdoms in the 1990s, was pictured with Tooro's King Oyo (right) in 2010 Uganda's traditional kings have no formal political authority, but they retain cultural influence and command significant loyalty in the communities they lead.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The country is home to four main kingdoms, the largest and most prominent being Buganda in the central region, which encompasses the capital Kampala.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The kingdoms were abolished in 1967, but the government under President Yoweri Museveni restored them in the early 1990s.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The government said this was to promote cultural pride and national unity, but the move has also been interpreted as a way of appeasing communities and fostering political loyalty.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Amid the succession dispute, the government backed the Babiito clan's choice of Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Attorney General Sam Mayanja said the Tooro kingdom was cleared to go ahead with the coronation, as there had not been a formal complaint against him.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The date of the coronation was announced by the government with President Museveni attending the ceremony.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The president's son and the head of the military, Muhoozi Kainerugaba, has also publicly supported Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "Long may he reign," he posted on X.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma's very name points to his royal heritage.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: His father, the first Kijanangoma, was born in the year King Rukidi III became king.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The king gave him the name, which means the "one who comes with the royal drum".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The drum of royalty, foretold two generations earlier, is now returning to its bearer.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma was born in 1970 and raised at their family home at Kidukuru village in Fort Portal, about 300km (186 miles) from Kampala.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: He left the village to pursue further studies and graduated with a mass communication degree from Uganda's prestigious Makerere University in 1999.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: He worked as a broadcaster in a career spanning more than two decades, including in neighbouring Rwanda and at home, with the Uganda Broadcasting Corporation (UBC).
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma has been a journalist for much of his adult life The years spent engaging with the public, the interactions with leaders and the exposure to national affairs in his work as a journalist may yet serve him well as he returns to the community he came from, this time as their leader.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: After he was named king, Kijanangoma said he would use the connections he had built up over 21 years working as a journalist "to get good things for our people".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: His mother, Assimwe Yusta Kijanangoma, is confident that he is well prepared for his new role.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: She says his upbringing was deeply rooted in tradition.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "I really raised him with the teachings of the old kingdom of a cane and instructions and scolding.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: I laugh with him, and other times I scold him," she told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: She added: "Eddy is well-mannered, he does not fight, or shout, even when wronged, he says a few words and does not go so much into it." She feels good for her son, although she admits to having mixed emotions, especially as her son is taking over after the death of a "great man".

sentences.text: Ademba Allans is making it "cool" to vote in Kenya.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: The student journalist turned civic mobiliser launched a voter registration drive on social media earlier this year, using snappy selfies infused with music and humour to target young people.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: The result astonished him and many observers of Kenyan politics – by the time the registration period ended, 2.6 million new voters across the country had signed up.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: He is aiming to get another 2.3 million on board in the next round.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "It was the Gen Z way of doing politics," he tells me.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "Fun, trendy, sexy, fashionable.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Because of how we created the hype around it, people had the fear of missing out.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Everybody wanted to be involved." Gen Z, the term used to describe people born in the late 1990s and early 2000s, burst onto the scene two years ago with mass protests that forced the government to retreat on a widely unpopular tax bill.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: But their victory was followed by a police crackdown that killed and injured dozens of demonstrators.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Now many young Kenyans are planning to move from the street to the ballot box, angry with a political establishment they accuse of corruption and police brutality.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: And they have the numbers to make a difference - more than 30% of voting-age Kenyans are younger than 35.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Polls suggest President William Ruto is looking vulnerable.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: But can Gen Z convert a decentralized digital-led rebellion into organised political power?
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "These youth-led movements are a wild card, in that they are unpredictable," says political analyst Tom Mboya.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "They don't require much in the way of resources and can pop up at any time.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: The finance bill protests were political in nature, but the movement has not been tested at an overtly political level.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: So if they decide to support a candidate, then he's likely to do fairly well." One of the strengths of the digitally savvy Gen Z activists is that they have been able to mobilise outside the party structures and ethnic allegiances that anchor Kenyan politics.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Allans has been careful not to advocate a particular candidate or party – emphasising leadership rather than politicians, marshalling a new force, he says, outside traditional tribal voting blocs.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "There has never been a case where there is a bloc that is not affiliated to any person or any party.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: They just want to vote in the right leaders, and this is what we created," he says.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "It's more of a swing vote because you cannot tell who we are going to vote for." Ruto and his United Democratic Alliance (UDA) are facing strong head winds with less than a year to go before the August 2027 vote.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: More than three-quarters of respondents to a survey conducted in June felt the country was moving in the wrong direction, with two-thirds saying their personal economic situation had worsened since Ruto was elected in 2022.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: But analysts argue that the president does not necessarily have to be popular to win.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: He is a master political organiser with the resources of the state, they say.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Ruto's political rivals are also fragmented, and it is not yet clear whether they can form a united opposition to take him on.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: Senator Edwin Sifuna has managed to draw large and youthful crowds to his rallies One man who has captured the attention of many Gen Zs is Nairobi Senator Edwin Sifuna.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: He has emerged as the leader of a movement called Linda Mwananchi (Protect the Citizen), which is getting strong support from disaffected young people.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: He has yet to officially declare a run for the presidency, but is already on the road rallying support.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: The BBC caught up with him on a recent trip to Meru county in central Kenya, a region that voted strongly for Ruto in the last election.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "Young people want us to create an environment where everybody feels that they can compete fairly," he told me before starting out on his raucous road show.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "We need to absolutely dismantle the system so that everybody has a fair chance at life, a fair chance at education, a fair chance at employment, and the opportunities to grow themselves.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "This election in 2027 is when this theory that the young people are advancing will be put to the test," he said.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "Our challenge as a leadership is to ensure you have a compelling message that then encourages people to come out, let them see the vision for the new country." Ruto also had a compelling vision for the country when he came to power in 2022.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: He promised to transform the economy from the bottom up, with a focus on lifting the marginalised.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: His government has since introduced changes including landmark reforms that widen access to public healthcare, but many young people felt betrayed by his austerity measures and tax hikes.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "I'm here to participate in a revolution change that we want a new Kenyan youth leader who knows the common problems that are facing the young people," 23-year-old Brandon Muremi told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: I found him in a relatively quiet corner of the final stop in a hectic day of a "rolling rally" – Sifuna's convoy visited four locations, sometimes blocking traffic as he and local politicians climbed on top of their vehicles and delivered rousing speeches at ear-splitting volumes.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.text: "We are looking for a leader who sticks to his plans, not just talking the promises that he makes," agreed Conrad Mutangili, a 19-year-old mechanical engineering student who had come out of curiosity.
sentences.article_title: Making politics 'fun, trendy, sexy': How Gen Z could shape Kenya's next election

sentences.article_title: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows

sentences.text: This video can not be played Watch: How Brazil's dramatic election unfolded Flávio Bolsonaro's success in Brazil's presidential election is being hailed as the result of a "blue wave" - the latest example of a resurgence of right-wing support sweeping Latin America.

sentences.text: But despite missing an outright majority – meaning there will be a second round later this month – the unexpectedly clear first round victory leaves his left-wing opponent needing an unprecedented result to retain the presidency.

sentences.text: Senator Bolsonaro is the eldest son of ex-president Jair Bolsonaro, who became known as the "Trump of the Tropics" due to his ideological alignment with the US president.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: The younger Bolsonaro is 45 years old and is part of the-right wing political dynasty initiated by his father.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: He had never before run for the presidency and surprised observers by finishing ahead of the 80-year-old president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, of the Workers' Party.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: All polls had indicated a close race, with Lula and Bolsonaro statistically tied.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: Flávio obtained 56.1 million votes, while Lula received 53.8 million.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: Part of Bolsonaro's success at the ballot box may be related less to his popularity and more to the numbers of people rejecting Lula.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: Bolsonaro has presented himself as a dynamic young politician connected to the demands of younger voters, including concerns about rising crime rates in a country that records more than 40,000 homicides annually.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.text: But polling groups such as Datafolha, one of Brazil's most respected institutes, suggest that this election has been a battle of rejection rates.
sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election

sentences.article_title: Flávio Bolsonaro rides right-wing wave to win first round of Brazil election
